reusedNationalArtifact.reuseReason: Pennsylvania incorporates the federal noxious-weed list as Class C. The complete verified national artifact already projects federal regulatory applicability to Pennsylvania, so it was not downloaded or duplicated for this state review.

review.reviewMethod: Deterministic review of the controlled-hemp row and all sixty-one explicit Class A, B, and C source rows followed by exact current-catalog binomial matching only.

contradictions.subject: statewide-class-description-versus-county-occurrence
contradictions.priorState: The official page describes Class A weeds as established but geographically limited and Class B weeds as widely established in Pennsylvania.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The page does not provide a complete reviewed county mapping for every listed taxon.
contradictions.resolution: Only state regulatory applicability is recorded. The class descriptions create no county presence claim.

contradictions.subject: class-c-description-versus-negative-evidence
contradictions.priorState: The official page describes Class C weeds as not known to exist in Pennsylvania.
contradictions.currentEvidence: That regulatory class definition does not document an exact-scope survey method, effort, time, or negative result for each catalog species and county.
contradictions.resolution: Class C exact list membership may establish state regulatory applicability only. It creates no verified absence, not-detected, county, or not-applicable claim.

contradictions.subject: incorporated-federal-list-versus-duplicate-acquisition
contradictions.priorState: The Pennsylvania page incorporates the federal noxious-weed list by default as Class C.
contradictions.currentEvidence: A complete verified APHIS national artifact already exists and already projects its accepted federal applicability events to Pennsylvania.
contradictions.resolution: The national artifact was reused. One duplicate state acquisition and one provider request were prevented.

contradictions.subject: controlled-hemp-row-versus-invasive-species-scope
contradictions.priorState: The page separately identifies Cannabis sativa under the controlled-hemp program.
contradictions.currentEvidence: That row is outside the page's Class A, B, and C noxious-weed lists and does not by itself establish current invasive-species applicability under the reviewed policy.
contradictions.resolution: The row is preserved and blocked for separate category review. It creates no applicability or county event.
